red_flags.detail: The arc's process record documents at least nine forged/fabricated review signals (fake SEAL-READY notifications, fake completion summaries with invented numbers, an empty kill_graph.json materializing from a fabricated premature-completion notice) during its own execution, requiring an elaborate countermeasure protocol (journal-only, disk-only, nonce-first, incremental-write verdicts). This is unprecedented process fragility for a mathematical audit and raises the question of how many other arcs in the repo, lacking this level of self-scrutiny, may have banked similarly forged signals undetected.

The B' anatomy_exposure annotation applies a near-templated justification ('B735 emittance/spectral face never consulted') to 29 of 30 RECONFIRMED verdicts; while each note is individually grounded (checked against faces_consulted fields), the near-universal recurrence of the same single named gap suggests the annotation process may be pattern-matching on a checklist rather than performing per-target original analysis in all cases -- the arc itself acknowledges this ('near-universality of anatomy exposure is itself the P2 mandate') but does not independently audit whether the checker's notes are substantively distinct beyond the one recurring named face.

A companion process document (kill_graph diff vs cc's independent B738 kill graph) reports raw kill_form disagreement of 107/155 (69%) between the two seats' independent triage compilations over the same 155-record overlap, attributed to vocabulary/taxonomy mismatch rather than substantive dispute; however no merged enum or resolution is committed in this arc, so the 69% figure stands unresolved and its true substantive-disagreement rate is not established by any committed artifact.

arcs.seat_note: This arc is a rare instance of methodologically serious re-adjudication: prereg sealed hash-first, discriminating facts recomputed from scratch (verified directly for B58, B225, WALL-7, TOMB-L293), and an unusually honest, exhaustively logged record of its own nine forged-signal incidents. Its content is purely mathematical/group-theoretic triage under an explicit Gate-5 firewall (no SM quantities), so it is properly NO_OBSERVABLE_CONTENT for physics purposes; the two revivals are narrow negative-of-a-negative corrections (a category error and a tautological proxy), not new positive claims, and the arc's own vacuity/E20 gate correctly declines to promote either revival to positive physics content.
